effects.review_evidence: Candidate review credit fails closed. Generated test keys exercise signature mechanics only and cannot satisfy this production registry.
effects.run_completion: Issue #327 can validate the frozen baseline contract, but the production candidate comparator fails closed and downstream_product_verdict remains NOT_RUN until a trusted run attestor is configured. Test-only keys never satisfy this release policy.

chain_trust.configuration_rule: A separately reviewed release-contract change must pin an exact canonical registration artifact by prior Git commit/path/SHA-256/blob. That artifact binds the genuine genesis, prior ledger head, and both private baseline hashes; release policy activation must strictly postdate registration and predate every review decision. After the first correction, each registration binds the exact prior ledger commit, SHA-256, Git blob OID, sequence, and record hash before any extension can run.
chain_trust.current_effect: No production correction sensitivity can run until genuine chain roots and production reviewer identities are registered; the preregistered primary analysis currently applies zero corrections.

sensitivity_estimands.corrected_source_counterfactual_reselect: Separately rerun result-blind queue selection from corrected source primitives and report exact private additions/removals plus aggregate denominator changes. This is not the frozen ITT estimand.
sensitivity_estimands.fixed_frozen_intent_to_treat: Recompute corrected evidence and outcomes while retaining every original ITT artifact, opportunity binding, pair-side membership, and denominator.

decision_rule.CONTINUE: Integrity and every safety gate pass, and at least one museum pair gains at least two credited distinct specific identity classes; each side has credited affected records >= max(1, ceil(0.10 * its fixed nonempty O_pair_side)); and broad-only share over X_m strictly decreases on at least one side without increasing on the other.
decision_rule.INVALID: Any schema, hash, exact-population, exact-inventory, pre-freeze, review-artifact, or other integrity failure. No product conclusion is allowed.
decision_rule.REDESIGN: Integrity passes, but any baseline identity-root loss exists; newly blocking records exceed 5/1000 of X_m for any museum (resolved blockers cannot offset them); or any top-1/top-5/top-10 unique-record-union ratio or incidence HHI exceeds its side-specific limit.
decision_rule.STOP: Integrity and safety pass but no pair satisfies every CONTINUE utility condition.

review_census.citation_subject_binding: For each review artifact, the exact authenticated non-originating-museum source records cited collectively cover every target_id field in the signed decision subject; unrelated-target citations provide no support.
review_census.credit_gate: Census of every credited new-link, strict-refinement, and equivalent decision with two structured independent artifacts.
review_census.held_out_sample: Optional descriptive audit only. If used, sort all non-credited candidate decision keys by SHA-256('site-graph-v0-descriptive-audit-v1' + U+0000 + decision_key), then take the first min(100, ceil(0.10*N)); freeze the resulting key list before review.

evidence.known_reproduction_limit: The archive does not record its export command, producer Git revision, or Dagster run identifiers. Its frozen bytes can be authenticated and extracted deterministically, but the upstream historical export cannot be regenerated bit-for-bit from repository history; baseline_base_commit is the evaluated checkout, not an asserted export-generator commit.

limitations.effect: The authorized handoff bytes are verified, but the historical export cannot be regenerated from repository history because its export command, code revision, and pipeline run identifiers were not supplied.
